scope: User asks for a better layout for nine Gibus PDFs, including mobile.
brief: Use case ui-mockup. Refine ONLY the Gibus PDF catalogue section in the existing LGE Home Solutions website, keeping identity. User now has 9 product PDFs and requests a better organization especially on mobile. Reference is current dark catalogue section (upper cropped product photo and header are surrounding context, not part of redesign). Create realistic production UI concept, exact colors charcoal #252a30 fullbleed band, white text #ffffff, muted #dad7d1, sand #edd5b3 accents. Cormorant Garamond serif heading and family headings, DM Sans body and PDF rows. No logos, photographs, covers, decorative cards, badges or new metrics. NO eyebrow above main heading: remove old 'Da sfogliare'. Main heading exact 'Cataloghi Gibus.' with Gibus italic sand, scale44px desktop and32px phone. Intro exact 'Modelli, finiture e configurazioni. Apri il catalogo della soluzione che ti interessa.' 14px line1.8. Link 'Tutti i cataloghi Gibus' with thin external SVG arrow sand. Group catalogues: 'Pergole' has 'Pergole bioclimatiche', 'Energy Pergola', 'Pergole inclinate', 'Pergole a 90°'; 'Tende e schermature' has 'Tende a bracci', 'Tende a caduta', 'Schermature Zip', 'Tende in trazione'; 'Vetrate' has 'Vetrate scorrevoli'. Each PDF link is a simple open row on dark background, at least48px target, white DM Sans14px label, muted small PDF suffix and sand thin external arrow. Fine semitransparent white separators, no individual filled/bordered cards. Implementation React/TypeScript/CSS Modules; copy and controls code-native, accessible keyboard/focus/aria expanded. All9PDFs link to real official documents; no CMS, search, fake form or extra families. Existing outside-site header/footer/hero/showcase photographs remain unchanged. New quick 'Cataloghi' link will also be added to existing page hero actions to reach this section; not shown in section crop.
